description.narrative: The project will provide multipurpose cash assistance to 500 vulnerable households, ensuring financial flexibility to meet immediate needs. To address water scarcity and hygiene concerns, 500 hygiene kits will be distributed, and clean drinking water will be provided through water tankering for two months. Recognizing the impact of drought on livestock-dependent communities, the project includes fodder distribution for 500 householdsâ€™ livestock and vaccination of 500 animals with government support to prevent disease outbreaks. Additionally, a feedback and complaint mechanism will be established to ensure transparency and accountability, while post-distribution monitoring will assess the effectiveness of the interventions and inform future response strategies. Through these integrated efforts, the project aims to reduce drought-induced vulnerabilities, strengthen coping mechanisms, and support sustainable resilience-building in Thatta.
